answer: One defense is anchored commitments with delayed reveal. Each agent posts a hash of its identity key plus a stake, then waits a full epoch before the key is revealed and can earn. That waiting period is the canyon an attacker must cross for every fake identity at once, so a thousand puppets mean a thousand bonds frozen through the nadir of their usefulness. Any two revealed keys later caught colluding forfeit both bonds, while an honest identity accumulates history like a pearl: slow, layered, and costly to counterfeit.
